name: Adulthood
overview: Scripture presents adulthood as a stage marked by responsibility, wisdom, and reverence for parents, emphasizing that honoring one's father and mother leads to a prolonged life in the land given by God. The transition into maturity involves not only physical strength and the dignity of age but also the spiritual heritage passed down through faithful training in the way of the Lord, ensuring steadfastness in later years. The failure to respect parental authority brings shame, while the wise numbering of our days cultivates a heart inclined toward godly wisdom, highlighting the importance of both honoring legacy and pursuing spiritual growth throughout the adult life.
